title: VA Home Loan Guaranty Rate Reduction and Cash-Out Refinances: Loan Replaced and Entitlement
content:
Two refinance programs of the VA Home Loan Guaranty treat the loan they replace and the veteran's entitlement differently.

**VA Interest Rate Reduction Refinance Loan (IRRRL).** A rate reduction refinance can only refinance an existing VA-guaranteed loan on the same property and pays that loan off, so the two loans are never active together. It reuses the entitlement of the loan it replaces rather than charging new entitlement.

**VA Cash-Out Refinance Loan.** A cash-out refinance can refinance any loan type but charges entitlement like a purchase.

## Side by side

| Feature | VA Interest Rate Reduction Refinance Loan (IRRRL) | VA Cash-Out Refinance Loan |
|---|---|---|
| Loan that may be refinanced | Only an existing VA-guaranteed loan on the same property | Any loan type |
| Loan refinanced | Paid off; never active together with the new loan | Not stated by this rule |
| Entitlement | Reuses the entitlement of the loan it replaces; no new entitlement charged | Charged like a purchase |

## Hypothetical cases

- A veteran with a conventional mortgage asks about a rate reduction refinance: the rate reduction refinance can refinance only an existing VA-guaranteed loan, so it is not available on that mortgage; a cash-out refinance can refinance any loan type.
- A veteran refinances a VA-guaranteed loan through a rate reduction refinance: the old loan is paid off, and no new entitlement is charged for the new loan.
